description: This file is a PHP source code for the 'Activity' controller class in the OpenCart admin dashboard extension. It manages actions related to dashboard activity including display, saving settings, and returning activity data for the admin interface.

classes.name: Activity
classes.description: Controller class for managing dashboard activity in OpenCart admin extension.

methods.name: index
methods.description: Main method to display the activity dashboard, setting up breadcrumbs, loading data, and rendering the view.

methods.name: save
methods.description: Handles saving dashboard activity settings, including permission checks and updating configuration.

methods.name: dashboard
methods.description: Returns the dashboard view with recent activities, loading necessary models and formatting activity comments.
